name: Kevin McCombs
headline: Director of Professional Services at Retail Information Systems (RIS)
about: Experienced Director of Professional Services with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Business Process, Retail, Sales, Databases, and IT Service Management. Strong consulting professional graduated from SMU Advanced Computer Education Center.

experiences.description:
As Director of Professional Services I manage a team of people to  build upon Retail Pro version 8 and Retail Pro version 9 applications with customizations and add-ons.  If a client has a specific need that Retail Pro does not natively perform, then that is where we come in. We work with the client to create applications and plugins providing functionality that is needed so the business' day to day activities are streamlined and optimized.  We handle everything from simple ‘Add a fee to every credit card receipt’ to complex ERP, Warehouse Management System, Supply Chain and accounting system integrations.

Retail Information Systems serves and consults with customers who operate Large Chain Stores, Small Chain Stores, E-Commerce, Apparel, Department, Boutique, Shoe, Toy, Furniture, Hardware, Gift, Electronics, plus many more!

RIS provides cost-effective, highly configurable and scalable Point of Sale and Inventory Control software solutions, such as Retail Pro, to retailers worldwide. No matter how your business grows, RIS will partner with you to bring your business the right tools: Store Operations, Merchandising, and Business Intelligence, along with experienced in-house customization services.
